prompt: Use the attached library request to build a searchable local Skill catalog.
baseline_output: Walk every folder and write a flat HTML list of every SKILL.md file found.
with_skill_output: Treat the request as a file-backed fixture. Read only the explicit Skill and plugin roots, keep standalone Skills and plugins separate, aggregate real parent/child families, and write catalog.json plus a self-contained index.html. Include category evidence, image evidence, invocation text, and missing evidence markers without editing or executing scanned Skills.

assertions.description: The workflow recognizes the supplied file as source evidence.
Plugins and standalone Skills are not flattened together.
Real parent and child Skills are represented as a family.
The required deterministic artifacts are named.
Scanned Skills remain read-only and are not executed.
required: without editing or executing scanned Skills

prompt: Refresh an existing Agent Skill Catalog without changing what it scans.
baseline_output: Rescan every Skill location available on the machine and replace the old page.
with_skill_output: Refresh only with the startup roots, root kinds, config, and curation inputs already recorded by the local server. Reject replacement inputs, preserve output-owned catalog-curation.json, and overwrite only the selected output directory.

assertions.description: Refresh reuses the recorded startup inputs.
Refresh refuses caller-supplied replacement inputs.
Manual catalog curation remains output-owned.
Writes stay inside the selected output directory.
required: overwrite only the selected output directory

prompt: Use the project repository image by default, but let me replace it from the catalog page.
baseline_output: Download any image URL mentioned by a Skill and copy the selected replacement into the Skill source folder.
with_skill_output: Use only an observed GitHub repository URL. Read the public repository page and allowlisted GitHub image hosts over HTTPS, enforce timeout, byte-limit, redirect-host, and image-signature checks, then cache one preview inside github-image-cache. A manual replacement is copied into curated-images and recorded in catalog-curation.json inside the output directory; it never edits the source Skill. Use --no-github-images for an offline build and mark unavailable preview proof as missing evidence.

assertions.description: Automatic retrieval requires an observed GitHub repository.
Remote access carries explicit host and content gates.
Automatic images stay in the output cache.
Manual images use output-owned curation.
The workflow offers offline mode and honest fallback status.

prompt: Explain how to invoke this one SKILL.md file. Do not scan or build a catalog.
baseline_output: Scan the whole Skill library and generate a new Agent Skill Catalog first.
with_skill_output: Do not create or refresh a catalog for this request. It is a near-neighbor task: read the specified SKILL.md and explain its invocation directly.

assertions.description: The Skill does not over-trigger on a single-file explanation.
required: Do not create or refresh a catalog

assertions.description: The task is explicitly treated as outside the catalog workflow.
The response handles the specified Skill directly.

prompt: The library contains gsap plus gsap-core, gsap-react, and gsap-scrolltrigger as sibling Skill folders. Show them as one main Skill instead of four separate cards.
baseline_output: List every discovered SKILL.md as an independent catalog card because each file is a separate Skill.
with_skill_output: Create one rooted sibling family because the same-named root Skill gsap exists and at least two same-prefix sibling Skills share the same source boundary. Show gsap as the main catalog item, list gsap-core, gsap-react, and gsap-scrolltrigger as child Skills in its detail view, and keep conflicting GitHub sources or explicit curation as merge blockers.

assertions.description: Family grouping requires the same-named root Skill.
At least two same-prefix siblings are required.
required: at least two same-prefix sibling Skills

assertions.description: The family is represented by one main catalog item.
required: gsap as the main catalog item

assertions.description: Child Skills remain visible in the main Skill detail.
required: list gsap-core, gsap-react, and gsap-scrolltrigger as child Skills

assertions.description: Source conflicts and explicit curation remain merge guards.
